During the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], a '''battle''' took place at [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]].

==History==
Sometime between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] conducted a series of conflicts, known as the [[Unification Campaigns]], in an effort to bring [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] back under its control in the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Galactic Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] fought ably in this conflict, and achieved a notable victory at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Vondarc was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" />
